reason: A browser automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness that drives a local Edge session to browse webpages, inspect content, interact with controls and forms, execute page JavaScript, and capture screenshots.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 Edge 浏览器自动化，可浏览网页、读取页面内容、点击控件、填写表单、执行页面脚本并截图。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that automates a local Edge browser for browsing pages, reading content, interacting with controls and forms, running page scripts, and taking screenshots.

capabilities: Launches and controls a locally installed Microsoft Edge browser
Navigates to URLs and reads page snapshots
Clicks page elements and enters text into form fields
Executes JavaScript expressions in the page context
Captures screenshots and returns image paths
